title: Reactor Initialization
storyContext: The reactor's primary initialization sequence has failed. We need to send a valid initialization signal to the control system.
objective:
Display the following exact output:
REACTOR INITIALIZED
POWER: STABLE
starterCode:
# CODEQUEST MISSION 01: Reactor Initialization
# Systems Engineer: You
# AI Companion: ARIA

# Broadcast the exact initialization signal using print():
# Line 1: REACTOR INITIALIZED
# Line 2: POWER: STABLE

print("REACTOR INITIALIZED")
print("POWER: STABLE")

hints.title: Concept Reminder
hints.content: Python uses the built-in print() function to write text or numbers to standard output.

hints.title: Logical Direction
hints.content: Invoke print(...) twice in sequence. Each print invocation automatically places its argument on a new line.

environmentEffectOnPass.message: Reactor Core Stabilized. Plasma Circulation Nominal.
